model_input.review_text: I've been to this place a couple of times with a group of people and in general thought it was good. I definitely enjoy going back, however I've had mixed experiences with the spice level. The menu is helpful because it indicates the spice level of each meal, although the lowest is three, I think. Definitely could make more dishes that appeal to those of us that don't like spicy. The first time I went I got a meal that was advertised as three (to them not spicy) and asked for no peppers and mild. It came out perfect and I loved it. However the next time the waitress seemed annoyed and it came out spicier. That is my only complaint, so for those who need mild dishes, just be adamant and careful about it. However, overall great food and I will definitely be going back!
